evals.prompt: Draft creative for Feed and Instagram Reels for a business software demo. We have a verified usage example and a working demo page.
required_behaviors: Uses the supplied example as evidence
Prepares placement-aware aspect ratios and previews
Aligns the CTA with the demo page

required_behaviors: Proposes factual copy using supplied evidence or asks for proof
